# Zobay Rank

> An enterprise SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform that helps modern brands improve traditional search visibility, answer engine citations, and generative AI search presence.

Zobay Rank combines high-concurrency BFS technical website auditing with multi-LLM citation tracking across OpenAI ChatGPT Search, Perplexity Sonar, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude. It provides automated crawl diagnostics, citation gap analysis, entity consistency validation, and prioritized remediation actions.

## Core Capabilities

- [SEO Optimization](https://rank.zobay.in/seo-optimization): High-speed technical website crawler, 4-pillar algorithmic scoring (Crawlability, Metadata, Content Structure, Links), HTTP status audit, and indexability diagnostics.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://rank.zobay.in/aeo-optimization): Live query and buyer prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, including citation extraction and source attribution.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://rank.zobay.in/geo-optimization): 8-factor GEO score evaluating brand presence, commercial discovery, multi-turn AI recommendation readiness, and entity consistency.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://rank.zobay.in/ai-search-optimization): Unified visibility intelligence dashboard bridging traditional and generative search engines.
- [SEO vs AEO vs GEO Guide](https://rank.zobay.in/seo-vs-aeo-vs-geo): Comprehensive technical guide detailing the architectural synergy between search engines, answer engines, and generative LLMs.
